title: authzcov waivers.yaml (schema authzcov.waivers/v1)
description: Editor and documentation schema for .authzcov/waivers.yaml (as JSON). authzcov validates the file itself in Go; this schema is informational. A bare top-level list (no schema key) is also accepted. A past expires date loads fine and is reported as an expired waiver; a date more than 365 days ahead is rejected.

endpoint.description: Exact endpoint ID, or a pattern where * matches any run of characters (e.g. "GET /admin/*", "* /health"). Must be non-empty after trimming whitespace; the Go parser is authoritative.

reason.description: 10–500 characters (Unicode code points) after trimming surrounding whitespace; the Go parser is authoritative.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD, at most 365 days after today.
